description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to add startup tasks that execute during the silo startup process in Orleans. It includes helper methods for adding tasks using dependency injection and manages their lifecycle to be run at specified stages.

classes.name: StartupTask
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ILifecycleParticipant<ISiloLifecycle> that encapsulates a startup task to be executed during a specified lifecycle stage.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
methods.description: Generic method to add a startup task of type TStartup, which executes during silo startup at a specified stage.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
methods.description: Method to add a specified IStartupTask to execute during silo startup at a specified stage.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
methods.description: Method to add an asynchronous startup task defined as a Func that takes IServiceProvider and CancellationToken, to run at a specified lifecycle stage.
